title: Spectrum Analyzer
text: Display frequency spectrum, 4 inputs, no direct feedthrough, {Style} sets Line style; {Spectrum} sets the type of spectrum, {Spectrogram} sets the type of spectrogram, {Sample Rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate the scope uses, {Offset (Hz)} sets the offset to apply to frequency axis, {Num Inputs} sets the number of input ports, {Open at Simulation Start} sets the automatically open scope when simulation, {Display Precision} sets the precision of data in scope display, {Y-Label} sets the y -axis label, {Y-Limits} sets the y -axis limits, {Title} displays title character vector, {Show Grid} shows internal grid lines, {Color Map} sets the spectrogram colormap, {Color Limits} sets the color limits of spectrogram, {Plot Type}, {Font Size} sets the font size of labels, {Background} sets the window background, {Axes}, {Labels} sets the color of labels, {Line} sets the channel for line property settings channel, {Visible} sets the channel visibility, {Width} sets the line width, {Marker} sets the data point markers, {Color} sets the line color, {Legend} shows or hide signal, {Colorbar} shows or hide color, {Layout} sets the stack axes vertically or horizontally vertical, {Copy to Clipboard} sets the send display, {Preserve Colors} sets the preserve colors when copying to clipboard, {Print}, {Input Domain} sets the domain of the input, {Frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency vector, {Input Unit} sets the units of frequency, {Estimation Method} sets the spectrum estimation method, {Resolution Method} sets the frequency resolution method, {Filter Sharpness} sets the sharpness of lowpass filter, {RBW (Hz)} sets the resolution bandwidth in Hz, {Window Length}, {FFT Length} sets the length of FFT, {Averaging Method} sets the smoothing method, {VBW (Hz)} sets the video bandwidth, {Forgetting Factor} sets the forgetting factor of weighted average, {Spectral Averages} sets the number of spectral averages, {Frequency Span} sets the frequency span mode, {Span (Hz)} sets the frequency span to compute spectrum in Hz, {Center Frequency (Hz)} sets the center of frequency span in Hz, {Start Frequency (Hz)} sets the start frequency, {Stop Frequency (Hz)} sets the stop frequency, {Window}, {Attenuation (dB)} sets the sidelobe attenuation in dB, {Overlap (%)} sets the percentage of overlap, {Channel}, {Data Cursors} enables cursor measurements, {Snap to data} sets the snap cursors to data, {Lock cursor spacing}, {Peak Finder} enables peak finder, {Num Peaks} sets the maximum number of peaks to show, {Min Height} sets the level above which scope detects, {Min Distance} sets the minimum number of samples between adjacent, {Threshold} sets the minimum difference between height of peak and its neighboring, {Label Peaks}, {Distortion} enables distortion measurements, {Distortion Type} sets the type of measurement, {Num Harmonics} sets the number of harmonics to measure, {Label Harmonics}, {Label Frequencies}, {Phase Noise} enables phase noise, {Frequency Offsets (Hz)} sets the frequency offsets in Hz, {Plot Target Phase Noise} sets the option to plot target phase noise profile, {Target Phase Noise (dBc/Hz)} sets the target phase noise profile in dBc/Hz, {Label Phase Noise} sets the option to label measured phase noise, {Two-Sided Spectrum} enables two-sided spectrum view, {Normal Trace} sets the normal trace view, {Max-Hold Trace} sets the maximum hold trace view, {Min-Hold Trace} sets the minimum hold trace view, {Frequency Scale} scales of frequency, {Reference load (Ω)} sets the reference load in Ω, {Spectrum Unit} sets the units, {Full Scale} sets the full scale for dBFS units, {Time Resolution (s)} sets the time resolution in seconds, {Time Span (s)} sets the time span in seconds, {Upper Mask} enables upper spectral, {Lower Mask} enables lower spectral, {Upper Limits} limits for upper spectral, {Lower Limits} limits for lower spectral, {Reference Level (dBr)} sets the reference level for mask power values, {Frequency Offset (Hz)} sets the frequency offset in Hz, {Channel Measurements} enables channel measurements, {Type}, {Occupied BW (%)} sets the percentage of power to compute occupied, {Num Pairs} sets the number of adjacent channel pairs, {Offsets (Hz)} sets the aCPR offsets in Hz, {Adjacent BW (Hz)} sets the adjacent channel bandwidth in Hz, {Filter Shape}, {Roll-off Factor}, {BT Product}, {Channel Names} sets the input channel names, {Maximize Axes} sets the maximize size of plots, {Axes Scaling} sets the y-axis scaling mode and {Number of Updates} sets the number of updates before scaling. Values come from the instance.
